for_the_owner: Judgment call: CoP (2605.28812), Dex-X (2609.07747) and TMA (2611.18976) were added as models although their policies are trained in simulation; recorded hand touch enters through real-world deployment (and CoP's 2,400-contact calibration set), following the PTLD and FBI precedent.

Judgment call: HT-Bench (ht_bench) was added as an announced dataset although the glove of its new recordings is not named and part of it is existing OpenTouch and EgoTouch data; its HandTouch model links both as training data.

Judgment call: Dex-X's Hugging Face release Ruoqu/DexX-Force (10,343 trajectories, 13.14 h, 8.2 GB) was not added as a dataset because its five-finger contact forces are simulated; it is described in the dex_x model's own_data.
